observedBug.description: Click loaded the sample below the viewport without moving to it. Existing visibility checks did not verify viewport placement. A subsequent mobile regression test exposed source-consumed notification occurring before the reading action was enabled.

fixes: Open and focus the reading action after React commits the selected source.
Display the selected filename beside its action and label the native picker as optional replacement.
Follow actual parsed components and successful CAD generation with guided viewport/focus navigation.
Apply a bounded PDF download timeout and signature/size validation; recover failed preloading on user retry.
Show download errors beside the launch button and retain a usable retry action.

source.kind: Clearly labeled synthetic measured PDF, not customer data or a prerecorded model.

productionScenarios: Unmocked PDF ingestion, explicit measured extraction, actual browser OpenCascade CAD generation (24000 mm3), width edit, real STEP download and reviewed design handoff to patent research.
Injected preload network failure followed by successful mobile retry, viewport/focus checks, keyboard extraction and example restart.
Injected HTML download error remains visible and can be retried with the actual public PDF.
checksPassed: Private trace scan: 41 manifests, zero private entries

scopeNotes: Guided stage navigation is enabled only for the example; standard Studio navigation is preserved.
External AI and patent search remain separate explicit actions. No external AI or research requests occurred during the CAD/export/handoff test.
Mobile browser evidence is emulation, not a physical Safari device test.
